With the Sun nearly **50° below the horizon**, the sky is fully dark.

Look toward the **southwest**, about **21° above the horizon**—roughly two fists held at arm’s length above it. In clear conditions, an ordinary unaided observer should have no trouble seeing it, unless buildings, mountains, trees, haze, or strong local light pollution block that part of the sky.
